summary: <cite index="5-1,28-1">Walmart reported its weakest sales growth in over six years, sending shares slumping Thursday</cite>, while <cite index="1-5,4-8">30-year Treasury yields climbed back to 5.25% after the government's bond buyback intervention faded</cite>. <cite index="4-10">Gold rallied 3.6% this week to $4,540, reflecting persistent safe-haven demand</cite> even as equity futures showed modest gains. The week's most dramatic move came in crypto: <cite index="45-6,45-9">Bitcoin surged 7.1% and Ethereum jumped 17.5% Thursday after President Trump pushed Congress to pass the Clarity Act</cite>, which would define regulatory treatment for digital assets. <cite index="21-1,21-2,21-3">The SEC also announced proposed rules providing a framework for crypto companies to raise capital, defining registration exemptions for crypto-related investment contracts</cite>. Markets remain on edge as <cite index="4-7">Treasury's extra long-bond purchases total only $14 billion per quarter against a $32 trillion market</cite>, leaving rates vulnerable and dampening risk appetite heading into Friday's session.

signals.title: Walmart misses on weakest sales growth in 6+ years
signals.desc: Retail giant's disappointing quarterly results signal consumer softness and pressured discretionary spending into year-end.

signals.title: Treasury buyback intervention reverses as 30-year yield hits 5.25%
signals.desc: Long-duration bonds sold off despite doubled buyback plan, erasing Wednesday's rally and keeping pressure on equity valuations.

signals.title: Trump crypto policy push sparks Bitcoin rally above $69K
signals.desc: President's call for Clarity Act passage triggered 7% BTC and 17.5% ETH surge, signaling regulatory tailwinds ahead.

signals.title: SEC proposes crypto fundraising framework with exit path
signals.desc: New rules allow crypto projects to exit securities classification after fulfilling commitments, benefiting mature networks like Bitcoin and Ethereum.

signals.title: Gold extends weekly gain to 3.6% as safe-haven bid persists
signals.desc: Spot gold at $4,540 reflects ongoing caution despite equity bounce, suggesting investors hedging rates and geopolitical risk.

verdict: Crypto surges on regulatory clarity while equities wobble under persistent bond-market pressure and consumer weakness—expect choppy trading with defensive rotation intact.
